title: The Celtic Cross tarot spread explained
description: The Celtic Cross tarot spread explained: its ten cards, the cross and the staff, how the two halves work and when this spread suits a question.

scenes.headline: The Celtic Cross tarot spread explained
scenes.caption: The Celtic Cross is a ten-card tarot spread that looks at one situation from many sides. Here is how the cross and the staff fit together.
scenes.vo: The Celtic Cross is a ten-card tarot spread that looks at one situation from many sides. Here is how the cross and the staff fit together.

scenes.headline: The shape of the spread
scenes.caption: The layout has two parts. Six cards form a cross on the left. Four cards form a vertical staff on the right.
scenes.vo: The shape of the spread. The layout has two parts. Six cards form a cross on the left. Four cards form a vertical staff on the right.

scenes.headline: What the two halves do
scenes.caption: A helpful way to think about it: the cross describes the situation, and the staff describes you and what surrounds you.
scenes.vo: What the two halves do. A helpful way to think about it: the cross describes the situation, and the staff describes you and what surrounds you.
